batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b UT Yadav

batting.dismissal: c G Gambhir b UT Yadav

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b DJ Muthuswami

batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c KM Jadhav b NM Coulter-Nile

balls.text: taken! That was full and wide and Mathews had a big slog at it, got a thick outside edge that was going a long way to the right of the keeper, but Uthappa dived across, at full stretch, and came away with the ball in his right glove
slower ball outside off, beats Mathews again as he looks to club it into the leg side
yorker on off stump, Mathews can't connect as he makes room and tries to jab it away through point
shortish on off stump, steered to third man

full and wide, flat-batted to long-off. Coulter-Nile ran back for the second, Mathews sent him back, and he had no chance of turning back and making his ground as the fielder, Manish Pandey, fired in a low, flat throw to the keeper
full-toss on off stump, clears his front leg and swipes it over the bowler, bounces down to long-on

flat and full on middle stump, and that is superb from Angelo. Moved his front foot out of the way and whipped it with a lot of bottom wrist to power it away into the gap to the left of deep midwicket
now it's Coulter-Nile's turn to slog-sweep from outside off, a more controlled version, all along the ground to deep midwicket
down the track now and Narine bowls it wide outside off. Swings through the line and drives to long-off
looks for the same shot again, the length was shorter, ends up tennis-forehanding it past the bowler, to the left of long-on
and again. This one's bowled wider outside off, and Mathews hits this over wide long-on with a full, free swing of his arms
tossed up on off stump and now it's Mathews' turn to slog-sweep Narine for six. Opened up his body as he did so to hit it square, over the deep square leg boundary
full outside off, and Jadhav picks out backward point. Makes room to slice it away, hits it fairly well, but straight to the fielder, who catches it just above head height
slower ball outside off, waits for it and steers it towards deep point
length ball angling down leg. Looks to swipe it away through square leg, misses, hits his pad and rolls to the left of short fine leg
length ball on the pads, whipped away to deep midwicket
slower length ball angling down the leg side. Mathews has a swing at it, doesn't connect
length ball wide outside off, chopped away off the front foot to the right of backward point
full on off stump, clipped away to long-on
a bit slower now, closer to off stump, and he slog-sweeps again, in the air this time, and timed really well, clears deep midwicket with ease

super placement, that. It was tossed up wide outside off, and he had to get down really low, reach out a long way, and use his wrists to execute that slog-sweep well enough to split the gap between deep midwicket and long-on
back of a length on middle stump, worked away through midwicket
down the track now and Narine shortens his length, gets it to spin quickly into him and hit his pad as he tries to work it leg side
big appeal for caught behind, not given. Shortish outside off, not enough room to cut, bounces over Jadhav's bat
offbreak outside off, back of a length. Jadhav looks to steer it towards third man, doesn't connect
Jadhav walks down the pitch and Russell bangs it in, back of a length, tucking him up for room. Pushes it away towards point
full outside off, checked drive to the right of short cover, where Yusuf makes a diving stop
back of a length on off stump, another off-cutter, cramps Mathews for room. Shaping to punch through the off side, he ends up pushing it back to the bowler
length ball outside off, slower ball. Looks to poke it away towards third man, chops it onto the ground and it rolls to the keeper
full outside off, driven firmly to short extra cover
back of a length on off stump, squirted away wristily towards mid-off

what was Yuvraj doing? It was a length ball on leg stump, and Yuvraj didn't connect with the sweep. Wandered out of his crease as it rolled to the keeper, and before he could realise it the bails were off - he took so long realising it that Uthappa missed the stumps once and took the bails off the second time

this one is short enough, just about. He was waiting deep in his crease, and he pulled this from outside off, powerfully, to the straight midwicket boundary. Lovely transfer of weight, swivelling through the hips
goes deep in his crease to pull, wasn't anywhere near short enough to do that, and he brings his bat down just in time to jab it  back to the bowler
down the track, drags this slowish delivery from outside off to deep midwicket
sees Yuvraj shaping to skip down the pitch, fires it in flat on his pads. Tucked away quietly to deep square leg
tossed up wide outside off, googly. Mathews was initially looking to drive through the off side, ended up hitting it off the inside half of his bat to long-on
back of a length on off stump. Yuvraj looks to poke it into the off side for a quick single, it's too close to him, and he ends up jabbing it down into the pitch
back of a length on middle stump, worked away to deep midwicket
short ball outside off, and Tiwary's out after a good start. Plays a shovel-pull, doesn't hit it as sweetly as he'd like, and pops a simple catch to short midwicket
full and wide. Tiwary has to reach a long away away from his body to try and force it away, can't connect
back of a length, angling across, chopped away towards backward point
shot! That was back of a length, fourth-stump line, and Yuvraj was waiting for it. Cleared his front leg a touch and pulled it away over the midwicket boundary
back of a length on leg stump, tucking up Yuvraj. Looks to work it away into the leg side, ends up dropping down into the pitch, off the bottom edge
again he sees him coming, making room, and fires it full, on the stumps. Yuvraj pokes it into the covers for a quick single
sees him striding down the pitch and shortens his length, sliding it across Yuvraj, who stretches his front pad out to block into the off side
shot. Sees this tossed up outside off, in his hitting zone, and he swings his arms through and sends it whistling over the bowler's head. Clean, flat hit
length ball on off stump, slides away with the angle. Yuvraj presses forward and blocks
tossed up on leg stump, and Yuvraj nearly falls over as he sweeps this powerfully to deep square leg
sees him come down the track, fires it into his feet. Pokes it away towards long-on
tossed up on leg stump, presses forward to defend watchfully back to the bowler
back of a length outside off, whipped with the turn to short fine leg
goes deep in his crease to a fullish ball on off and middle, defends into the leg side

this one straightens into Yuvraj, and it nearly hurries on and smacks him in the pad as he prods halfway forward. Moves his front leg out of the way in a hurry and jams his bat down to squirt it away through square leg
sharp turn there. Slanted across Yuvraj, and turns away further. Yuvraj looks to defend initially, leaves it in the end, tucking his bat away inside the line
back of a length on off stump, goes on the back foot to work it into the leg side
back of a length outside off, helped away to the left of third man
short again and this time Tiwary is in a much better position. Back and across and pulls it powerfully to the left of the square leg umpire

ooh. That was banged in, angling into the body, and it bounced more than Tiwary expected. He had walked across, looking to tuck it towards the leg side, possibly from chest height, but it was nearer his head and he popped it off his glove, just wide of backward point
back of a length outside off, defended to short cover
length ball outside off stump, and Tiwary makes a lot of room to flat-bat it to the right of Russell at short cover
back of a length, angling down the leg side. Looks to walk across and tuck it fine, doesn't connect. Was very close to the top of leg stump, and not given wide
length ball on leg stump, tucked away to short fine leg
length ball on off stump, skips a long way across to work it to deep square leg
flat length ball fired into the pads, tucked away to deep backward square leg
back of a length on off stump, goes on the back foot to punch to long-on
length ball on leg stump, tucked away to short fine leg
starts with a length ball outside off, and Tiwary knows his field well. Third man is inside the circle, and he plays what could be described as a reverse-glance between the keeper and that fielder
length ball, straightens towards middle stump. Shuffles across to work it to short fine leg
length ball on middle stump, tucked away through midwicket
bowled him. Was going for the slog-sweep, may have been playing for the turn. Went through straight and crashed into off stump
length ball on leg stump, tossed up. Tiwary can't beat short fine leg with his sweep
a bit of flight outside off, very full. Shreyas uses his wrists to force it away powerfully to the right of sweeper cover
tossed up on middle and leg. Iyer clears his front leg to slog it over the leg side, ends up dragging it off the inside half of his bat towards square leg
on the pads and Tiwary says thank you and glances neatly to the fine leg boundary
back of a length on off stump, punched off the back foot to long-on
bouncer over off stump. Iyer thinks of hooking, ends up checking his shot and leaving the ball
shortish outside off, carved away to point
length ball on leg stump, and he clears his front leg and slogs it away cleanly over the wide long-on boundary
stays back to a length ball angling in towards leg stump, keeps a bit low and he has to jam his bat down quickly to defend into the on side
length ball on off stump, swiped down the ground to long-on
back of a length on middle stump, makes room to punch it to sweeper cover
sees him come down the track and bowls a loopy googly. Hits Tiwary on the pad as he sticks it across to try and work it into the leg side
back of a length, goes with the angle towards off stump as Tiwary rocks back to cut. Ends up dragging it back to the bowler off the inside half of his bat
shortish ball on off and middle. Makes room to slap it away towards sweeper cover
gets this all wrong, pushes it a long way down the leg side, and Uthappa had no chance of cutting it off
starts with a non-turning ball that slides towards leg stump. Tiwary gets his front leg across and clips it towards short fine leg

shortish ball on off stump. Gets behind the line to bunt it into the on side of the pitch and run a quick single. Russell sprints through from his follow through, picks up, and hits the stumps direct at the keeper's end, but Iyer was well home
back of a length outside off, beats Tiwary, who walks across and has a poke at it
short ball, angling into the body. Iyer leans away and plays a controlled slap to third man
shot! That was a length ball on off stump, and Iyer seemed to be waiting for it. Simply moved his front leg out of the way and flat-batted it down the ground, in the air to the right of mid-off
back of a length, angling in towards off and middle. Shuffles across to work it towards midwicket
back of a length on off stump. Iyer stands tall and punches into the covers
back of a length on a fourth-stump line. Again Tiwary shuffles across to work it to square leg
back of a length on off and middle. Tiwary shuffles across and tucks it into the leg side
length ball, offbreak on an off-stump line, and Tiwary immediately plays the paddle, gets it fine enough to beat short fine leg and run away for four

bowled him! That was an offbreak pitched outside leg stump. Duminy went for the sweep, the ball may have bounced more than he expected, and it hit the top of his pad, and maybe his glove as well, and ricocheted onto leg stump. Looked like pad onto forearm.
tossed up on off stump, driven into the covers
back of a length on off stump, pushed towards short cover for a single. The fielder throws to the bowler's end, misses, and gives up an overthrow
back of a length on middle stump, and that's a super shot from Iyer, just shuffled across and played a back-foot on-drive that raced away to the midwicket boundary
length ball on middle stump, jumps across to poke it towards mid-on
length ball on off stump. Iyer stays inside the line and jabs his bat down a touch late, bounces down towards slip
short and wide, and Iyer's feet go off the ground as he slashes it away, off the middle of the bat, over backward point
length ball on off stump. Iyer comes half-forward and pushes it into the covers
a little fuller and wider this time and he comes forward, looking to drive on the up, slices it to backward point
length ball on a fourth-stump line, and that is super timing from Duminy. Just stands there and opens his bat face to find the gap between backward point and cover point
shortish ball, angling into middle and leg and cramping Iyer for room. Swivels around in an ungainly manner to half-pull, half-whip it to long leg
full outside off. Iyer clears his front leg and has a merry old swipe at it, hits it along the ground, straight to mid-off
short ball on off stump, pulled in the air, but was in fairly good control of it, bounces down to the left of the fielder at deep square leg
shortish, angling in towards off stump. Iyer stands tall and chops it down towards third man
fuller now, fourth-stump line. JP is too early into his attempted extra-cover drive, ends up dragging it towards mid-on
back of a length on off stump. JP shuffles across, looks to work it into the leg side, inside-edges into his pads
back of a length, tucking up the batsman on an off-and-middle line. Lets it come on and bunts it into the off side for a quick single
shortish, outside off. Goes for a slash away from his body and doesn't make contact
back of a length, slides down the leg side
shortish ball, too quick for Agarwal to pull, hurries through, and he top-edges it high in the air for Umesh to take a sprawling catch at long leg
back of a length, fourth-stump line, blocked towards point
length ball angling in towards middle stump. Agarwal stays inside the line and looks to poke it away through the off side, inside-edges it towards square leg
full-toss, swinging away from outside off to beat Agarwal's bat. Was looking for an angled-bat drive
another wide. This one wasn't the bouncer, just a back-of-a-length ball gone wrong. Was trying to cramp Agarwal for room
bouncer, angling down the leg side. Looks to swivel and hook, doesn't connect
back of a length in the corridor. Clears his front leg and tries to hoick over the leg side, doesn't make contact
length ball, angling in towards off stump. Stays leg side of the ball and slaps it to point
back of a length, fifth-stump line, a bit of bounce and away movement to beat Agarwal's swishing bat. Was looking to slash through the off side, but no footwork
back of a length, angling into the body. Agarwal looks to clip it through the leg side, can't connect, is hit on the upper thigh
another googly as RTD shuffles across his stumps, and he whips it away towards deep backward square leg and picks up two to give Knight Riders the easiest possible win they could have imagined
googly turning towards off stump, and Tendo, who was on the front foot, adjusted and sliced it away towards short third man
chops it on. Gives himself room to cut, it turns just enough and doesn't bounce as much as expected, and he ends up inside-edging into his off stump
length ball on off stump, dabbed towards wide slip
full on middle stump, driven to long-on
tossed up outside off, and Yusuf has hit the roof. Just swung his bat through a big arc and hit it way over long-on, hit one of the upper-tier roofs and bounced back into the ground
fullish on off stump, pushed to long-off for one
legbreak, tossed up slow outside off. Yusuf goes for the sweep, doesn't connect
tossed up on off stump, googly, sliced over the off side, bounces down to sweeper cover
short on off stump, flat-batted powerfully to long-on
back of a length on off stump, chopped to backward point
googly, turns away sharply from off stump. Gambhir goes on the back foot and whips it wristily back towards the bowler, who gets down quickly but can't stop it cleanly and concedes a single
shortish on off stump, Gambhir makes room to cut it away to the right of sweeper cover
back of a length on off stump, punched hard into the ground, bounces up to the point fielder
back of a length, close to off stump, and this is an excellent shot from Yusuf, stays leg side of the ball and slices down on it to send it racing away to the right of third man
short, wide, sits up at a friendly pace, and Yusuf lashes it away to the square cover boundary
and again. This time the umpire signals one bouncer for the over. Maybe the previous one didn't bounce as much as this one
bouncer now, Yusuf semi-ducks under it
full on middle stump, Yusuf clears his front leg and whips it away to the midwicket boundary
back of a length on off stump, waits for it and dabs it towards short third man
shortish ball angling down leg, and Yusuf simply has to help it to the long leg boundary
length ball on middle and off. Gambhir stays on the back foot to work it away towards deep backward square leg
shortish on off stump, pulled to long-on
length ball outside off, keeps a bit low as Yusuf aims a slap through point. Ends up chopping it towards short third man
back of a length on off stump, whipped away to deep midwicket
back of a length on a fourth-stump line, punched to sweeper cover
short ball, gets big on Yusuf, climbs to head height, and he's cramped for room but manages to make decent contact with a checked hook and play it towards long leg
back of a length outside off, dabbed down to third man
shortish, angling into the hips, helped away to long leg
back of a length on off stump, dabbed away to third man
starts his spell with a long-hop on off stump and Gambhir gets to his fifty by pulling it to the boundary in front of square leg
short, wide, and Yusuf slaps it fiercely to the cover boundary. I think Mishra gripped it too tight and it simply didn't come out of his hand right
very full on middle and off, whipped away to deep midwicket
tossed up on off stump and Yusuf stretches out to sweep to deep backward square leg

big shout for lbw, not given. That looked close. Came out of the front of the hand, I think, and went with the angle. Yusuf pressed forward to defend, playing for turn, and it seemed to strike his pad in line of off stump. Lucky boy, Yusuf.
a bit of turn for Mishra, very slow turn. Pitches outside off, turns further away, and Yusuf has time to adjust and poke it towards point
length ball, hurries through into Yusuf, who brings his bat down in a hurry to tuck it into the leg side
shot. That was a length ball, just a bit of width outside off, and he leaned back and sliced it away into the gap between point and sweeper cover
back of a length, angling in towards off stump, chopped to short third man
low full-toss outside off, and Gambhir clears his front leg and puts it away into the gap to the left of sweeper cover
back of a length close to off stump, dabbed to short third man
length ball outside off, beats Gambhir as he makes room to shovel it over cover
back of a length outside off, chopped away to backward point
tossed up slow outside off, left alone
short ball, and Yusuf is back in a flash to pull it away to the midwicket boundary
back of a length on off stump, Gambhir rocks back and plays a half-pull-half-punch to long-on
slower now, tossed up on off stump, and Yusuf plonked his foot forward to play the lap sweep towards fine leg
ooh. Yusuf went on the back foot there, looking to make room to cut, and it was the googly, cramped him as he jammed his bat down and inside-edged it between his legs towards fine leg
flat and quick, slides on towards middle and leg, tucked away towards midwicket
shortish outside off and he's gone! Looked for that late dab again, ended up sending a thin edge into the keeper's gloves
slower ball outside off, keeps low, goes under Suryakumar's bat as he looks to play a crouched slash
length ball outside off, and he simply clears his front leg and flat-bats it to the right of mid-off
back of a length outside off, steered down to third man
lets this back of a length ball come on to him, and plays a late dab to the right of the keeper. Tahir anticipates well at third man and sprints to his left to cut it off
shortish outside off, hops in the air to dab it down to third man
shortish and wide. Gambhir has to reach out a long way to cut, can't connect
fullish and flat on off stump, comes forward to work it through midwicket
full on off stump, whipped to long-on
short outside off, turns away, gives him enough width to slice hard under the ball and hit it over the leaping backward point fielder
full on leg stump, clipped to short fine leg
length ball on middle and leg, tucked away to the right of long-on
short ball on leg stump, pulled to deep square leg
back of a length, quickish ball turning in towards off and middle, punched off the back foot back to the bowler
just a bit of air outside off, bowled with a round-arm action, and Suryakumar uses the width to swing his arms through the line and launch the ball over the boundary to the right of long-off
tossed up outside off, driven to sweeper cover
length ball on the stumps, worked away towards deep midwicket
fullish outside off, drifted away and continued to go away from the batsman after pitching. Looked to work it leg side and got a leading edge towards backward point
full on off stump, whipped away to the right of long-on
back of a length on off stump, Gambhir skips away from the line and pokes it to backward point
fullish on middle and leg, whipped away to deep backward square leg

length ball on off stump, was the googly and it turned away from Gambhir, who waited on it and steered it to short third man. They take on Amit Mishra's arm and win, just about. Direct hit and Suryakumar would have been out. Jadhav didn't collect cleanly either, and ended up hitting the stumps with his gloves
back of a length on off stump, makes room and jabs it to backward point
back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to sweeper cover
starts with a shortish ball, Gambhir drags his pull to deep square leg
fullish on middle and off. Gambhir stays inside the line and pokes it softly towards point
length ball outside off, comes in off the pitch as Suryakumar looks to poke it into the covers, gets an inside edge that ricochets off his back pad towards point
back of a length on a fourth-stump line, steered away to third man
length ball close to off stump, angling away. Gambhir looks for that dab to third man, gets an outside edge that races away to the left of the keeper
full and wide, and Gambhir puts it away with a crisp drive, brings his wrists into it and flays it away through square cover
back of a length on off stump, whipped into the gap between midwicket and mid-on
short ball, bounces steeply down the leg side as Suryakumar dips his left shoulder under it
length ball on off stump, straightened into Gambhir a touch. Wanted to push it into the covers, inside edged it into his back leg
on the pads and Gambhir flicks it away for another boundary, finds the gap to the right of short fine leg
short outside off, and Pandey has simply helped that into third man's hands. Leaned back to ramp it, and picked out the fielder
slog and miss. It was a length ball outside off and he cleared his front leg and was looking to smash that over mid-on
length ball outside off, punched to short cover
fullish outside off, and Uthappa simply doesn't time that. Looked to hit it over mid-off, and I think that hit the outside half of his bat, and he ended up chipping it straight to mid-off
short, angling into the body, pulled away to deep backward square leg
full on off stump, Gambhir plays a checked drive to the right of mid-off
length ball on a fourth-stump line, pushed softly into the off side for a quick single
length ball, a bit of width outside off, and Uthappa will be a little cross with himself that he hit it well but couldn't beat backward point
length ball outside off, jabbed towards backward point
overpitched on middle stump, and that's asking for trouble. Uthappa brings his bat down straight, and flicks his wrists at the last moment to send it racing away wide of mid-on

slower ball on off stump, Gambhir swings through the line and hits it over mid-on. Joseph chases back and dives to try and pull it back at the rope, almost twisting his ankle in the process. Don't think he managed to save any runs there. Ball hit the boundary cushion before he could pull it back
full on leg stump, fine leg is in the circle, and Gambhir flicks it away to his right. Deep square leg puts in the dive after running hard to his left, can't cut it off
length ball on middle stump, defended into the off side
length ball on off stump, plonks his front leg across and tucks it away towards mid-on
full, wide outside off, Uthappa can't connect as he reaches across trying to slap through point
length ball outside off, steered to third man
length ball heading towards leg stump. Gambhir misses the flick and it hits him on the pad. Pitched well outside leg stump
sharp bouncer outside off, too quick for Uthappa to hook
length ball slanting away outside off, Gambhir has a flash at it away from his body and slices it over the leaping gully fielder
back of a length on middle stump. Gambhir stays leg-side of the ball and jumps to poke it towards point
back of a length, angling in. Misses the flick and the ball hits his pad and ricochets towards third man

length ball down the leg side. Uthappa can't get his bat around his front pad to flick, and it runs off the edge of his pad to the left of the keeper, who doesn't make the greatest attempt to stop the ball. Feet were too wide apart, and he had no chance of diving across
back of a length outside off, dabbed to third man
length ball on off and middle, defended into the off side, picks up a single as Joseph and short cover converge on the ball
length ball outside off, comes forward and steers it to backward point
shortish outside off, slanting away. Gambhir slashes and misses
shortish on a fourth-stump line, dabbed away towards backward point
length ball outside off. Uthappa comes forward to defend and it keeps low, bounces to the keeper off the toe-end of the bat
length ball on middle stump and Uthappa shuffles across and times the flick beautifully to send it racing away to the long leg boundary
